title: Minimum parking for an ancillary dwelling, R40 and below, outside Perth and Peel (1)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Regional ancillary dwellings at R40 and below still need 1 space; Perth and Peel need 0 (C2.3.1-r1).
text: Applies to development outside of the Perth and Peel regions only. C2.3.3 Car parking is provided on site in accordance with Table 2.3b. Table 2.3b Car parking provisions for development outside of the Perth and Peel regions: Ancillary dwelling - Minimum parking space(s) for R40 and below (per dwelling) 1.
